_note: 學習路徑內容建置首批增量 #6／6：節慶與文化（eng.t_mid.vocab.festivals-culture，會考級 vocab）。核心字：festival、celebrate、tradition、fireworks（恆為複數）、gather、decorate。文化例句取台灣學生熟悉且無爭議的事實（農曆新年、中秋節吃月餅、放煙火），claims 聚焦字義（language-usage/definition）。字義/例句皆道地標準英語，待對抗式英語母語複核。teach 與 practice 皆兌現 KP id。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix fest_）。

units.can_do: 我能用英語談節慶與文化：festival（節日）、celebrate（慶祝）、tradition（傳統）、fireworks（煙火）、gather（聚在一起）、decorate（裝飾）。
units.situation_group: 談節慶與文化 Festivals & culture
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A 'festival' is a special day or period when people celebrate something, often as part of a culture.
claims.verification_ref: festival=節日/節慶；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To 'celebrate' means to do something enjoyable for a special occasion, such as a festival or birthday.
claims.verification_ref: celebrate=慶祝；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A 'tradition' is a custom or way of doing things that has been passed down within a group or family over many years.
claims.verification_ref: tradition=傳統/習俗；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'Fireworks' are devices that burn or explode to make bright colors and loud sounds in the sky, used at celebrations. The word is usually used in the plural.
claims.verification_ref: fireworks=煙火（常用複數）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To 'gather' means to come together in a group in one place.
claims.verification_ref: gather=聚集/聚在一起；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To 'decorate' means to add things to something to make it look nicer, especially for a special event.
claims.verification_ref: decorate=裝飾；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A festival is a special day or time when people celebrate something together. To celebrate means to do enjoyable things for a special occasion. A tradition is a custom passed down over many years.
teach.zh_hint: festival＝節日／節慶，人們一起慶祝的特別日子。celebrate＝慶祝。tradition＝傳統（一代一代傳下來的習俗）。

teach.body: We celebrate the Lunar New Year with our family. Eating mooncakes at the Mid-Autumn Festival is an old tradition.
teach.zh_hint: 我們和家人一起慶祝農曆新年。中秋節吃月餅是個古老的傳統。

teach.body: Fireworks are lights that burst in the sky with loud sounds at celebrations (the word is usually plural). To gather means to come together in one place. To decorate means to add things to make something look nicer.
teach.zh_hint: fireworks＝煙火（通常用複數）。gather＝聚在一起。decorate＝裝飾。

teach.body: On New Year's Eve, families gather for a big dinner and watch the fireworks.
teach.zh_hint: 除夕夜，家人聚在一起吃大餐、看煙火。

teach.body: We decorate the house with red lanterns for the Lunar New Year.
teach.zh_hint: 農曆新年我們用紅燈籠裝飾房子。

practice.stem: 人們一起慶祝的特別日子，英語叫什麼？

distractor_rationales.weekend: weekend 是週末，不一定是慶祝的特別日子。

practice.feedback: festival＝節日/節慶，大家一起慶祝的特別日子。

practice.stem: 把對的字填進去：On your birthday, you ____ with a cake and friends.（生日時你會和蛋糕、朋友一起慶祝。）

distractor_rationales.study: study 是讀書，和生日慶祝不合。

practice.feedback: celebrate＝慶祝（在特別的日子做開心的事）。

practice.stem: 中秋節吃月餅是流傳很多年、一代傳一代的習俗。這叫什麼？

distractor_rationales.mistake: mistake 是錯誤，不是流傳的習俗。

practice.feedback: tradition＝傳統，一代一代傳下來的習俗。

practice.stem: 除夕夜天空中五顏六色、會發出巨大聲響的光，英語叫什麼？

distractor_rationales.candles: candles 是蠟燭，不會在天空爆開、發出巨響。
distractor_rationales.flashlights: flashlights 是手電筒，不是天空的煙火。
distractor_rationales.stars: stars 是星星，不會爆開或發出聲響。

practice.feedback: fireworks＝煙火（常用複數），慶祝時在天空綻放。

practice.stem: 把對的字填進去：Families ____ for a big dinner on New Year's Eve.（除夕夜，家人聚在一起吃大餐。）

distractor_rationales.leave: leave 是離開，和『聚在一起』相反。

practice.feedback: gather＝聚集、聚在一起（families gather 家人團聚）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: We celebrate the New Year with fireworks.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：We、celebrate、the、New、Year、with、fireworks、句點有沒有漏。celebrate＝慶祝、fireworks＝煙火（複數）。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。都是陳述句，句尾自然下收；celebrate 重音在前（CE-le-brate）。

lines.text: We celebrate the Lunar New Year with our family.
Families gather for a big dinner on New Year's Eve.
